How to use Free Signature Generator

  1. Draw, type or upload your signature in the right panel.
  2. Click Download signature as PNG to save a transparent PNG anytime.
  3. Open a PDF, click a page where the signature should go, drag to move and resize.
  4. Click Download the signed PDF. The file is built locally; nothing is uploaded.

FAQ

Is it legally binding? No. This is not a qualified or certificate-based e-signature.

Is my PDF uploaded? No. Processing stays in your browser tab.
